verdict.rationale: Data export is a fair question for a search/vector database. The pack documents no export or bulk-download feature and no open export format. The closest items are adjacent: API compatibility that eases migrating between Orama Cloud and Orama Open Source, an open-source library, and on-prem deployment. None of these is a documented capability to export all of a user's data and leave.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can export all of my data in open formats and leave
